label: Some bearer has a greatest represented degree of the supplied being respect
paraphrase: Some bearer of the supplied being respect attains a greatest represented degree among bearers of that same respect.
note: This selected-being attainment is OPEN. It is not existence of a mere incomparable maximal element, a greatest bearer of every unrelated perfection, numerical uniqueness, actual-world existence or necessity. The source asserts maxime ens; its derivation and the application of supplied degrees remain independent obligations.
